title: When to do the optional control-byte cleanup in bundled third-party files (RC-6)
context: Two bundled third-party files (yaml in dist/chunk-H2GJD26E.js, graphlib in the graph-ui bundle) hold raw control bytes, so the directory reads them as binary. Cleaning them does not clear the blocking finding or the H9 hold (the files stay over 256 KiB); it only adds a post-build rewrite of released files. The choice is about scope, not about getting listed.
